relation.rationale: Passage 1: the prisoners are 'prevented by the chains from turning round their heads'. Now knowledge comes when the whole soul is 'turned' from becoming to being. Their trouble is direction, not missing sight.
relation.rationale_raw: Passage 1: the prisoners are 'prevented by the chains from turning round their heads'. Now knowledge comes when the whole soul is 'turned' from becoming to being. Their trouble is direction, not missing sight.

source.label: Learning as turning the soul
source.content: Knowledge requires turning the whole soul from becoming toward being, as the eye turns only with the whole body.

evidence.quote: the instrument of knowledge can only by the movement of the whole soul be turned from the world of becoming into that of being

target.label: Unable to turn round
target.content: The chains prevent the prisoners from turning their heads, so they face only one way.
target.reading: Not turning shows a soul whose power of sight is intact but faces the wrong way. Education is the turning the chains prevented.
